title: Efficient Betti Matching Enables Topology-Aware 3D Segmentation via Persistent Homology
mechanism: Persistent-homology loss with spatially induced matching between predicted and label barcodes (Betti matching, arxiv:2211.15272), in a fast C++ implementation.
adaptation: Crack class, components only, on label components >= 20 px. Weight 1e-5 to 1e-2 chosen on val (TRACE paper notes larger weights drop Dice).
min_experiment: PF + Betti matching vs PF, 5 seeds. Kill if component recall gain < 0.02 or crack IoU < PF - 0.012.
evidence: R (abstract): large speed-up over Cubical Ripser; improved topological correctness on several datasets. R (TRACE tables): Betti matching weaker than TRACE on DeepCrack.
